question: What is the term description, whether the term is current or not, total number of types of TIP subjects offered and materials needed, the minimum and maximum number of enrolled students, the total number of schools offering subjects, and the total number of records for each term code?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE terms AS
SELECT 
  term_code,
  term_description,
  is_current_term,
  term_status_indicator
FROM beaver."ACADEMIC_TERMS"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tip_subject_offered AS
SELECT 
  term_code,
  offer_school_name,
  num_enrolled_students,
  is_no_course_material,
  subject_id
FROM beaver."TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tip_detail AS
SELECT 
  term_code,
  subject_id,
  tip_material_key,
  tip_material_status_key,
  record_count
FROM beaver."TIP_DETAIL"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "terms" AS SELECT term_code, term_description, is_current_term, term_status_indicator FROM beaver."ACADEMIC_TERMS"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tip_subject_offered" AS SELECT term_code, offer_school_name, num_enrolled_students, is_no_course_material, subject_id FROM beaver."TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tip_detail" AS SELECT term_code, subject_id, tip_material_key, tip_material_status_key, record_count FROM beaver."TIP_DETAIL"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "terms" AS SELECT term_code, term_description, is_current_term, term_status_indicator, '' AS columns FROM terms
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tip_detail" AS SELECT term_code, subject_id, tip_material_key, tip_material_status_key, record_count, '' AS columns FROM tip_detail
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tip_subject_offered" AS SELECT term_code, offer_school_name, num_enrolled_students, is_no_course_material, subject_id, '' AS columns FROM tip_subject_offered

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH tip_base AS (
    SELECT term_code,
           subject_id,
           offer_school_name,
           CAST(NULLIF(num_enrolled_students, '') AS DOUBLE) AS num_enrolled_students,
           is_no_course_material
    FROM tip_subject_offered
),
materials_by_subject AS (
    -- subject has material if not explicitly flagged as no material, or has detail rows
    SELECT tb.term_code,
           tb.subject_id,
           CASE 
             WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(tb.is_no_course_material, 'N')) = 'Y' THEN 0
             ELSE 1
           END AS needs_material_flag
    FROM tip_base tb
),
materials_from_detail AS (
    SELECT term_code,
           subject_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT tip_material_key) AS material_items
    FROM tip_detail
    WHERE tip_material_key IS NOT NULL AND tip_material_key <> ''
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
material_needed_subjects AS (
    SELECT m.term_code,
           m.subject_id,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(mf.material_items,0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE m.needs_material_flag END AS needs_material
    FROM materials_by_subject m
    LEFT JOIN materials_from_detail mf
      ON mf.term_code = m.term_code AND mf.subject_id = m.subject_id
),
per_term_agg AS (
    SELECT tb.term_code,
           COUNT(DISTINCT tb.subject_id) AS tip_subject_types_offered,
           SUM(ms.needs_material) AS materials_needed_subjects,
           MIN(num_enrolled_students) AS min_enrolled_students,
           MAX(num_enrolled_students) AS max_enrolled_students,
           COUNT(DISTINCT tb.offer_school_name) AS total_schools_offering,
           COUNT(*) AS total_records
    FROM tip_base tb
    LEFT JOIN material_needed_subjects ms
      ON ms.term_code = tb.term_code AND ms.subject_id = tb.subject_id
    GROUP BY tb.term_code
)
SELECT t.term_code,
       t.term_description,
       CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(t.is_current_term,'N')) = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS is_current_term,
       p.tip_subject_types_offered,
       p.materials_needed_subjects,
       p.min_enrolled_students,
       p.max_enrolled_students,
       p.total_schools_offering,
       p.total_records
FROM terms t
LEFT JOIN per_term_agg p
  ON p.term_code = t.term_code
ORDER BY t.term_code DESC
LIMIT 50

# Produce per-term metrics only for terms present in TIP data, then include term descriptions/current flag by joining to terms.
sql = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH tip_base AS (
    SELECT TERM_CODE,
           SUBJECT_ID,
           OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
           CAST(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS DOUBLE) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
           IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL
    FROM tip_subject_offered
),
materials_from_detail AS (
    SELECT TERM_CODE,
           SUBJECT_ID,
           COUNT(*) AS detail_rows,
           SUM(CASE WHEN TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL AND TIP_MATERIAL_KEY <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_na_items
    FROM tip_detail
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
subject_material_flag AS (
    SELECT b.TERM_CODE,
           b.SUBJECT_ID,
           CASE
             WHEN COALESCE(m.non_na_items,0) > 0 THEN 1
             WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(b.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL,'N')) = 'Y' THEN 0
             ELSE 1
           END AS needs_material
    FROM tip_base b
    LEFT JOIN materials_from_detail m
      ON m.TERM_CODE = b.TERM_CODE AND m.SUBJECT_ID = b.SUBJECT_ID
),
per_term_agg AS (
    SELECT b.TERM_CODE,
           COUNT(DISTINCT b.SUBJECT_ID) AS tip_subject_types_offered,
           SUM(sm.needs_material) AS materials_needed_subjects,
           MIN(b.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students,
           MAX(b.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students,
           COUNT(DISTINCT b.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_schools_offering,
           COUNT(*) AS total_records
    FROM tip_base b
    LEFT JOIN subject_material_flag sm
      ON sm.TERM_CODE = b.TERM_CODE AND sm.SUBJECT_ID = b.SUBJECT_ID
    GROUP BY b.TERM_CODE
)
SELECT p.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
       COALESCE(t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,'') AS term_description,
       CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(t.IS_CURRENT_TERM,'N')) = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS is_current_term,
       p.tip_subject_types_offered,
       p.materials_needed_subjects,
       p.min_enrolled_students,
       p.max_enrolled_students,
       p.total_schools_offering,
       p.total_records
FROM per_term_agg p
LEFT JOIN terms t
  ON t.term_code = p.TERM_CODE
ORDER BY p.TERM_CODE DESC
LIMIT 50
"""

db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql)
